results.question: Show FIR cases registered in Bengaluru Urban district in the last 6 months
results.generated_sql:
SELECT cm."CaseMasterID", d."DistrictName", cm."CrimeNo", cm."CrimeRegisteredDate", ch."CrimeGroupName"
FROM "CaseMaster" cm
JOIN "Unit" u ON u."UnitID" = cm."PoliceStationID"
JOIN "District" d ON d."DistrictID" = u."DistrictID"
JOIN "CrimeHead" ch ON ch."CrimeHeadID" = cm."CrimeMajorHeadID"
WHERE d."DistrictName" = 'Bengaluru Urban'
  AND cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '6 months'
ORDER BY cm."CrimeRegisteredDate" DESC
LIMIT 200
